title: Factorial constant and book growth
statement: As $d$ tends to infinity through the natural numbers, $\frac{(3d)!^2}{(d!)^6}$ is of the same asymptotic order as $\frac{9^{3d}}{(3d)^2}$; their ratio is eventually bounded above and below by positive constants.
